title: The kb-sprint run step has no route for an item that waits on or overlaps another session's item, so the orchestrator asks the operator instead of settling it through coord
goal: skills/sprint/SKILL.md run section says what the orchestrator does when a ready item waits on, or shares files with, an item another live session holds: it follows the coordination settings (strategy.working for an item being worked, strategy.landing for one being landed), asks that session with kbask.py ask OTHER when the setting says ask, records the chosen strategy with kbask.py coordinate ITEM OTHER STRATEGY, adds or drops the depends_on to match and puts the choice to the operator only when strategy.decide is operator and neither a setting nor the other session's answer settles it, with kb/_self/backlog.md and kb/_self/coordination.md saying the same

run: import sys; t=open("skills/sprint/SKILL.md", encoding="utf-8").read(); r=t.split("## run")[1].split("## review")[0]; sys.exit(0 if "kbask.py coordinate" in r else "the run section names no coord route for a cross-session dependency or overlap")

repro_reason: The defect is an orchestrator's choice in a live run (an AskUserQuestion instead of kbask.py coordinate or an ask to the other session), which no command can replay; the repro reads the run section of the skill text that drives that choice.

run: import sys;t=open("skills/sprint/SKILL.md",encoding="utf-8").read();r=t.split("## run")[1].split("## review")[0];m=[w for w in ("strategy.working","strategy.landing","strategy.decide","kbask.py coordinate","--add-depends") if w not in r];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)

import sys;d=[open(p,encoding="utf-8").read() for p in ("kb/_self/backlog.md","kb/_self/coordination.md")];m=[i for i,x in enumerate(d) if "kbask.py coordinate" not in x or "strategy.decide" not in x];print(m);sys.exit(1 if m else 0)

notes: Found 2026-10-28 running SP-lmpjclxz: ST-xl4w2pmg depended on ST-qqpcgqe7 (session s-0e0c2d, returned with two open gates); the orchestrator put wait-or-drop to the operator with AskUserQuestion, and the operator asked why coord was not used. precheck had printed the route at planning (kbask.py coordinate ST-xl4w2pmg OTHER STRATEGY, from _tools/bl_precheck.py:515), and an ask to s-0e0c2d (A92f312cef4) was sent but never followed by a coordinate event. The run section of skills/sprint/SKILL.md names kbask.py ask only for steering one's own workers.
